gates.requiredScope: Before the unchanged installed Evidence Core runs, the feature-local pre-validator proves that every Supplemental item references the unique Primary item for its gate and that acceptedPreMergePath equals the configured literal runner path .specify/runtime/autonomous-routing/044b77ae-85fd-46ee-97f4-61ce7a2c9c66/premerge-gate-evidence.json with acceptedPreMergeSha256 equal to that file's normalized hash. The subsequent Core separately validates schema-2.0 PreMerge type, same reviewed head, existence, and supplied hash.
gates.primaryProof: Ordered output showing the feature-local pre-validator pass first and the unchanged Evidence Core pass second for postmerge-gate-evidence.json and the retained configured PreMerge snapshot.
gates.supplementalProof: The accepted PreMerge snapshot references the unique Primary binding item for this gate.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Primary/Supplemental reference, configured PreMerge path, hash, schema, snapshot type, reviewed head, pre-validator, invocation order, or evidence-core drift.

gates.requiredScope: The feature PR is actually merged under normal policy without admin bypass; actual PR number and URL, accepted head, base, merge method, and full merge commit are bound after execution.
gates.primaryProof: Post-event PR and Git record binding actual merge execution and merge commit to the accepted reviewed head.
gates.supplementalProof: Provider PR URL and merge status referencing the Primary record.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: PR, head, base, merge commit, method, policy, or provider evidence drift.

gates.requiredScope: After the feature merge, META-LH-03 is renamed exactly once through the paired-script contract in its own normally reviewed PR; lifecycle evidence binds logical and physical paths and actual lifecycle merge commit while Series and META-LH-02 remain unchanged.
gates.primaryProof: Merged lifecycle PR evidence with one actual rename, paired-surface equivalence, paths, heads, checks, approval, and merge commit.
gates.supplementalProof: Lifecycle JSON and provider URL referencing the Primary record.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Logical/physical path, Series, META-LH-02, script, PR, review, or merge drift.

gates.requiredScope: Causal closeout facts are written only after their events; exactly one normal closeout PR changes only the five exact repository closeout paths and proposes the terminal tasks/run-state transition without claiming its own merge; that transition becomes canonical only when the reviewed PR is merged without bypass, and the runner PostMerge snapshot is created only after this PR is actually merged and synchronized.
gates.primaryProof: PostMerge runner snapshot created after the closeout merge, binding exact event order, five-path candidate, checks, approval, PR, actual closeout merge, and synchronization.
gates.supplementalProof: Causal closeout evidence plus the merged transactional run-state/task target, neither of which claims its own closeout merge.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Event order, terminal state, path set, review, check, approval, PR, or merge drift.

gates.requiredScope: The final feature report contains, in order, Output, Findings, confirmed rules, interventions/repairs, efficiency observations, AEPS relevance, then Completion/Retrospective Evidence; after META-LH-03 completion it includes a source-path/hash-bound META-LH-01 to META-LH-02 to META-LH-03 comparison using one common metric and explicitly marks missing comparable evidence instead of inventing values.
gates.primaryProof: Final report review binding heading order, completion evidence, source paths, source hashes, metric definition, values, and explicit missing-data dispositions.
gates.supplementalProof: Run evidence and governance policy referencing the Primary report.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Completion evidence, heading, source, hash, metric, value, or comparability drift.

gates.requiredScope: After the material completion and retrospective trigger, AEPS relevance is assessed and recorded as new bounded evidence or justified no-new-evidence; the result grants no preset promotion, Level 0, remote, merge, or bypass authority.
gates.primaryProof: Final retrospective/run-evidence record with source-bound AEPS disposition and explicit authority boundary.
gates.supplementalProof: AEPS ledger/receipt reference pointing to the Primary disposition.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: New finding, learning, pattern, anti-pattern, evidence, or authority.

gates.requiredScope: After the normal feature, lifecycle, and closeout merges, main is synchronized fast-forward only to the remote head, the worktree is clean, ahead/behind is exactly 0/0, and the runner PostMerge evidence binds those already completed commits. The later two-path persistence transaction defined by the design contract is an outer-orchestrator epilogue after the routed Implement result and is not a prerequisite of this PostMerge snapshot.
gates.primaryProof: Runner PostMerge synchronization log after the closeout merge with actual heads, clean status, and 0/0.
gates.supplementalProof: Merged transactional closeout state that identifies the closeout target without claiming its own merge.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Local/remote head, worktree, branch, or ahead/behind drift.
